question: In June 2025, which regulatory authority approved Lenacapavir for HIV prevention?

options.text: United States Food and Drug Administration

solution:
The correct answer is __**United States Food and Drug Administration**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA)** granted approval for **Lenacapavir** as a breakthrough medication for **HIV prevention** in **June 2025**.
 
• **Lenacapavir**, marketed under the brand name **Sunlenca**, is developed by the biopharmaceutical company **Gilead Sciences**.
 
• It represents a revolutionary shift in **Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP)** as it is the first **twice-yearly (six-month)** injection approved for preventing **HIV-1 infection**.
 
• The approval was supported by data from the **PURPOSE** clinical trial program, which demonstrated superior efficacy compared to daily oral **PrEP** options like **Truvada**.
 
• The drug functions as a **capsid inhibitor**, a novel class of **antiretroviral** medication that targets the protein shell of the **HIV virus** at multiple stages of its lifecycle.
